question:
A part of the following sentence is underlined. Choose the option which can replace the underlined part to improve the sentence. In case Options A, B and C are not found suitable, choose Option D: “No Improvement Required.”

The members of the club have been waiting eagerly __for the chief guest to arrive since two hours__.

options.text: to the chief guest's arrival since two hours
for the chief guest to arrive for two hours
for the chief guest's arrival from two hours

solution:
The correct answer is '2'** for the chief guest to arrive for two hours**'.

• The sentence involves a description of an event that has been ongoing for a specific period of time in the present.
 
• The correct preposition to use in this case is "**for**" when referring to a duration of time (e.g., "for two hours").
